live_tv.tab.description: Label of the Live TV tab in the top tab strip; the tab shows only when the server has Live TV & DVR.

live_tv.tab.plex_channels.description: Tab in the Live TV guide's tab row: Plex's own free streaming channels (as opposed to the server's DVR channels).

live_tv.mode.guide.description: Live TV page header pill: shows the channel guide (a grid of channels and programs over time).

live_tv.mode.recordings.description: Live TV page header pill: shows upcoming DVR recordings and recording rules.

live_tv.state.loading.description: Live TV page read-out while the channel guide is being read from the server.

live_tv.state.unavailable.value: This server has no Live TV.
live_tv.state.unavailable.description: Live TV page read-out when the server has no DVR/tuner or this account may not use it.

live_tv.state.failed.value: The guide could not be loaded.
live_tv.state.failed.description: Live TV page read-out when reading the server's providers or channels failed; a Try Again button follows.

live_tv.state.no_channels.value: No channels are set up on this server's DVR.
live_tv.state.no_channels.description: Live TV page read-out when the DVR answered with an empty channel lineup.

live_tv.state.no_tab_channels.value: No channels in this category right now.
live_tv.state.no_tab_channels.description: Live TV page read-out when a Plex Channels category tab has no channels.

live_tv.action.retry.description: Button on the Live TV page's failure read-out: read the guide again.

live_tv.action.watch.description: Action on a program airing now in the Live TV guide: tune the channel and play it.

live_tv.action.record.description: Action in the Live TV guide: record this one program (an episode or a movie) on the DVR.

live_tv.action.record_series.description: Action in the Live TV guide: record every airing of this show (a series recording rule).

live_tv.action.stop_recording.description: Action on a program the DVR is recording right now: stop that recording.

live_tv.action.cancel_recording.description: Action on a program scheduled to record: do not record it.

live_tv.action.cancel_series.description: Action on a program covered by a series recording rule: delete that rule (no more episodes are recorded).

live_tv.action.move_top.description: Action on a recording rule: give it the highest priority when recordings conflict.

live_tv.action.move_bottom.description: Action on a recording rule: give it the lowest priority when recordings conflict.

live_tv.action.delete_rule.description: Action on a recording rule in the Recordings list: delete the rule and its upcoming recordings.

live_tv.action.close.description: Last action of the Live TV action panel: close the panel and do nothing.

live_tv.row.loading.description: A channel row of the Live TV guide whose programs are still being read.

live_tv.row.no_info.description: A channel row of the Live TV guide with no program listed for the time shown.

live_tv.row.failed.value: The guide couldn't be loaded for this channel · OK still plays it
live_tv.row.failed.description: A channel row of the Live TV guide whose program listing failed to load from the server (it is asked again once a minute); OK on the row plays the channel anyway.

live_tv.badge.recording.description: Badge on a program the DVR is recording right now.

live_tv.badge.scheduled.description: Badge on a program the DVR will record.

live_tv.badge.failed.description: Badge on a recording that failed.

live_tv.badge.on_now.description: Badge on a program airing right now in the Live TV guide.

live_tv.badge.new.description: Small badge in the corner of a Live TV guide cell whose airing is a premiere (a new episode or a first showing).

live_tv.episode.description: Season and episode numbers of a program in the Live TV guide, e.g. S2 E5.

live_tv.tuning.description: Shown while a channel is being tuned before live playback starts; BACK cancels.

live_tv.tune_failed.description: Shown when tuning a channel for live playback failed; the reason is the server's.

live_tv.notice.recorded.description: Notice after a Record press succeeded.

live_tv.notice.recorded_series.description: Notice after a Record Series press succeeded.

live_tv.notice.conflicts.description: Notice after a recording was scheduled that overlaps other recordings for the tuners.

live_tv.notice.cancelled.description: Notice after a recording or recording rule was cancelled.

live_tv.notice.stopped.description: Notice after a running recording was stopped.

live_tv.notice.moved.description: Notice after a recording rule was moved in the priority list.

live_tv.notice.failed.description: Notice after a DVR change failed; the reason is the server's.

live_tv.recordings.upcoming.description: Heading of the Recordings list section with recordings that will run (or are running).

live_tv.recordings.rules.description: Heading of the Recordings list section with the DVR's recording rules, in priority order.

live_tv.recordings.empty.value: Nothing is scheduled to record. Pick a show in the Guide and press OK to record it.
live_tv.recordings.empty.description: Recordings list read-out when there are no recordings and no rules.

live_tv.recordings.loading.description: Recordings list read-out while the DVR's recordings are being read.

live_tv.recordings.failed.description: Recordings list read-out when reading the DVR's recordings failed.

live_tv.recordings.now.description: Recordings list heading above the recordings the tuner is recording at this moment.

live_tv.recordings.today.description: Recordings list heading above the recordings scheduled for later today.

live_tv.recordings.tomorrow.description: Recordings list heading above the recordings scheduled for tomorrow.

live_tv.recordings.none_scheduled.value: No recordings are scheduled. Pick a show in the Guide and press OK to record it.
live_tv.recordings.none_scheduled.description: Note in the Recordings list when recording rules exist but no recording is scheduled; tells the viewer how to schedule one.

live_tv.hud.live.description: Shown on the player's progress bar while watching a live TV channel, in place of the elapsed time.

live_tv.rule.series.description: Kind of a recording rule in the Recordings list: records every episode of a show.

live_tv.rule.single.description: Kind of a recording rule in the Recordings list: records one program.

live_tv.tab.favorites.description: First tab in the Live TV guide's tab row: the account's favorite channels (the same list the official Plex apps show).

live_tv.state.no_favorites.value: No favorite channels yet. Move left onto a channel's logo and press OK to add it.
live_tv.state.no_favorites.description: Live TV page read-out on the Favorites tab when the account has no favorite channel this server or Plex offers.

live_tv.action.add_favorite.description: Live TV channel panel button: add this channel to the account's favorite channels.

live_tv.action.remove_favorite.description: Live TV channel panel button: take this channel off the account's favorite channels.

live_tv.notice.favorite_added.description: Live TV notice after a channel was added to the favorite channels.

live_tv.notice.favorite_removed.description: Live TV notice after a channel was taken off the favorite channels.

live_tv.conflict.body.value: It conflicts with {titles}: there are not enough tuners for all of them. Prefer this recording, or cancel it.
live_tv.conflict.body.description: Live TV panel after scheduling a recording that conflicts with others for the tuners; {titles} lists the other recordings' titles. Buttons follow: Prefer This, Cancel This, Close.

live_tv.action.prefer.description: Live TV conflict panel button: give the new recording priority over the ones it conflicts with.

live_tv.action.cancel_new.description: Live TV conflict panel button: cancel the recording just scheduled.

live_tv.options.title.description: Heading line of the Live TV panel that sets a recording's options (episodes, padding, how many to keep…) before it is scheduled or saved.

live_tv.options.library.description: Live TV recording options panel: the library the recordings go to ({name} is the server's library name).

live_tv.options.loading.description: Live TV recording options panel while the server's options are being read.

live_tv.options.failed.value: The options could not be loaded: {reason}
live_tv.options.failed.description: Live TV recording options panel when the server's options could not be read; {reason} is a short reason.

live_tv.action.edit_options.description: Live TV recording rule panel button: change the rule's recording options.

live_tv.action.save.description: Live TV recording options panel button: save a recording rule's changed options.

live_tv.action.cancel.description: Live TV recording options panel button: close it without recording or saving.

live_tv.notice.options_saved.description: Live TV notice after a recording rule's options were saved.

live_tv.mode.whats_on.description: Live TV page header pill: rows of what is on now and soon (the server's DVR), and the channels watched lately.

live_tv.whats_on.loading.description: Live TV What's On read-out while its rows are read from the server.

live_tv.whats_on.failed.value: What's on could not be loaded.
live_tv.whats_on.failed.description: Live TV What's On read-out when the server did not answer; a Try Again button follows.

live_tv.whats_on.empty.description: Live TV What's On read-out when the server has no rows to show.

live_tv.whats_on.recent.description: Live TV What's On row: the channels watched lately on this TV.

live_tv.badge.conflict.description: Badge on a scheduled recording that lost its tuner to recordings of higher priority (a conflict): it will not record unless one of them is cancelled or it is preferred.
